about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Jerusalem Taxi - Over 15 years of transportation experience
about.text: Jerusalem Taxi is a leading transportation company based in Jerusalem, providing reliable and professional taxi services throughout Israel. With a fleet of modern vehicles and a team of multilingual professional drivers, we guarantee our clients a safe, comfortable, and punctual travel experience. Whether you need an airport transfer, an intercity trip, or a tourist tour, Jerusalem Taxi is your best choice.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.subtitle: We are committed to making our website accessible to all users
accessibility.commitmentText: Jerusalem Taxi is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for all users, including people with disabilities. We continuously work to improve the user experience and apply the relevant accessibility standards.
accessibility.standardsText: This website conforms to Israeli Standard 5568 (WCAG 2.0 Level AA) and the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Law 1998. Our site is designed to be accessible to users with visual, hearing, motor, and cognitive disabilities.
accessibility.coordinatorText: For any accessibility requests or feedback, please contact our Accessibility Coordinator:
accessibility.complaintsText: If you encounter an accessibility issue on our website, please contact us by phone or email. We will respond within 14 business days.
accessibility.complaintsAlt: Alternatively, you may file a complaint with the Israeli Equal Rights Commission for Persons with Disabilities:
accessibility.commissionName: Commission for Equal Rights of Persons with Disabilities
